notes.title: Raiders of the Lost Island - a labor of love!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/11ecc716afd276cf12b9a200739bb9106925731b.png[/img]

Nominate Raiders of the Lost Island for Labor of Love Award!

Here are a few fun facts about it that you probably didn't know:
[list]
[*] Raiders of the Lost Island started at the Global Game Jam, back in 2017.
[*] Inspired from board games like Forbidden Island and the way my kids wanted to grab those beautiful treasures for themselves, despite endangering the whole team.
[*] It is my longest and biggest project as an indie game developer.
[*] It is the game me and my family played the most.
[*] Over 280 hours recorded in Steam, though we started long before the Steam version was ready.
[*] My 2 kids grew up raiding together... well, most of the time one against each other :D
[*] They just played today with their cousin. They lost :p
[*] Good anger management tool. We still struggle - watch our live broadcasts :)
[*] Created as a solo indie developer in my spare time. Lots of long nights and weekends... no regrets!
[*] Over 4 years of development, in total 3646 work hours until today.
[*] Released on 2 platforms: PC and Nintendo Switch.
[*] Released on 4 stores: Steam, Nintendo Store, Itch.io, and Stove Indie.
[*] Localized in 9 languages, including Korean now.
[*] Payed me back about $1.5 per work hour so far, but who's in for the money anyway!?
[*] Presented at Gamescom, Casual Connect London, Dev-Play, and many other.
[*] Helped me make many new friends among indie developers and players.
[*] Freshly updated after one year adding 50 skills... because my kid said she wants to play again :)
[*] A few more features left in the design document. But that's a story for another time...
[/list]
Keep close for more, as Raiders is here to stay!
Alex

notes.title: New Update: Raiding Skills
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/340a4fa6dc98dc5673b8f3dfaa311ddcf55b4d1b.jpg[/img]

A fresh new update, with a brand new feature: RAIDING SKILLS!
Level-up during your adventures by collecting XP coins, and choose from 50 skill cards, to refresh your raiding style.

How this works!? From each island you can collect one XP coin. It's worth 7 points, but most importantly, once you get enough of them (depending on the adventure length), your team will sail to a training island where each of you get to choose from a random selection of skill cards.

Some give you fighting advantages, some are used for surviving, some get you rich faster. There is one even to catch those rare baby birds when you crack the eggs. In total, there are no less then 50 skills to explore. And you can mix up to 3 of them, to find that winning strategy and drive your friends crazy!

And don't forget to review your equipped skills in the hideout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/ba6b479a391db7e7fd06e48177af1a9461db59e3.jpg[/img]

Beside this, a few other changes, fixes, and improvements, like the new shiny coins. Here's a quick list:
[list]
[*] now you must face the boat when you jump in, so you can fight easier around it
[*] automatically take your skull key if you leave into the final raid without it
[*] added master volume in sound options, and improved volumes control
[*] easier to shoot upwards at items placed a bit higher than you
[*] cool dance animation after doing the idle cool emote (Y,B)
[*] polished the gold and silver coins a bit
[*] new achievement: Party Bag
[*] added Korean language
[*] fixed moving in mud while loading the gun
[*] small fixes and polishes (boat trails, rock the boat when jumping in, etc.)
[/list]
I hope you'll enjoy this update, and equipped with the new skills, you and your friends will find your way back to the Lost Island. If you want to see us raiding hard join our live streaming on Steam Broadcast and on Twitch.

P.S. This week it all comes with a 50% SALE, so spread the word!

Have fun!
Alex

notes.title: Update v1.08
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/a8e1cf722d17bf2696ea84c53f2de3f488f33017.png[/img]

It has been reported that the Greedy Volcano is not a thing to joke about!

So, taking this feedback into consideration, me and this hard stone had a talk, and reached an agreement. We cut a passage, a shortcut to easy things a bit. And the big guy promised to go a easy when asking treasures from teams with 1 or two members.

Still, to survive it, keep in mind these two simple things:
1. When the earthquake starts, go and throw some of your treasures into the volcano, to quiet it down and avoid triggering the final wave early. Make sure you have something in your pockets for this.
2. Use your shooting skills to drop down resource bags placed on ledges. Avoid going all the way back for a second bag.

All in all, I hope raiding the Volcano island is now accessible to everyone!

[b]Update v1.08[/b]

 - fixed rift island that had a hidden hole under the mud layer
 - lowered a bit the minimum water level on the rift island, to give a bit more time at the final wave
 - balanced volcano island to be a bit easier (added a shortcut passage, tuned requested treasures and shakes)
 - polished some of the hats textures and made the hats fit some avatars heads better
 - added a glow line to the collection shelves when the player is facing them, to place items easier

notes.title: Feature Reel - The Adventure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/f14c3cba7ce4a7e294dbb159ecf6f2b04871b5cf.png[/img]

Ready for the real thing? Embark on a real adventure, go from island to island, loot them all, collect the relics, roll your luck, win it all at the end! That is if you survive, of course... One single mistake, and the whole thing ends up in tears.

Adventures come in all sizes. A small one has 5 islands. That's about 30 minutes, if you make it to the end. For the bravest of all, there is the epic adventure with 20 islands. All the lost islands in a row, including the special final ones. Surviving that is... epic.

[previewyoutube=ruOT3a6g0_o;full][/previewyoutube]

After each raid, go back to your hideout, score your loot, take some supplies, place your relics in your collection, make or break a team, try your luck, and deal with your frustrations in a civilized manner.

Before the last raid of an adventure, you score your relics. Keep a close eye on who has what, because these are quite expensive together. More about them in the future.

The final raid it's your last chance to get ahead. There's no boat building and the water goes up fast. If you make it off this final island too, the awards ceremony awaits and the after party, where you might feel generous to the less fortunate raiders, and toss a coin to them.

notes.title: Feature Reel - Fighting
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/0333a9a8eab1fdb3cac60488eddc9d30a59b4fbb.png[/img]

With all these treasures around, one must learn to defend what's theirs. What if it's in someone else's pockets? Take this class of RAIDJUTSU and get back in the game! Your friends will never know what hit them.

First, we have the efficient PUSH of death. Get behind your friends when they're close to a ledge, and push them into the waters to empty their pockets - button (A).

[previewyoutube=HsINBJ8tWS4;full][/previewyoutube]

Then, we have the classic TAKEDOWN. Grab your friends by holding (X) or (Y) button to take'em down and steal one of their treasures. Make sure to surprise them, because if they guess and hold the same attack button, they'll do a COUNTER-TAKEDOWN on you.

The advance LADDER TAKEDOWN is sometimes a rather desperate move. Drop down from a ladder and hold the (A) button while you pass by a friend who was climbing under you.

And if none of this kung-fu moves help, hold (B) button to charge your shotgun, aim well, and release!

But remember, in the end, friends or foes, you're all in the same boat!

notes.title: Feature Reel - Surviving
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/e32ee36af10e9d640a6a1d3ac7c79a7a199dc90c.png[/img]
Lost islands - easy to get on, not so easy to get off.

As all raiders know by know, these islands are cursed to sink in about 4 minutes, so take whatever you can, but make sure someone builds the boat!

[previewyoutube=itIu6QA7CeA;full][/previewyoutube]

To finish the boat you need to collect and drop 10 resource bags next to it's location. This will not make you win, but it will keep you floating. So, the best strategy is to convince other players to work hard for the cause. In fact, with all those treasures in their pockets, this is what they should do, right?

However, your building efforts won't go unnoticed. At the end of an adventure, the player who contributed the most will be awarded with a builder badge. Poor, but proud!

By the end, before the final wave goes all the way up, at least one player must be safe in the boat. If not, well... it's game over! Nobody wins, you don't even know who was ahead.

As they say, Win Alone Or Die Together!

notes.title: Feature Reel - Basic Looting
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4qRlGxhP7n4;full][/previewyoutube]
Basic looting - what all raiders of lost islands learn even since they start walking on two feet.

Collecting treasures is the main goal of the game. Get more than your team mates and you win at the end. Only you!

Keep in mind the scores:
[list]
[*] silver  $1
[*] gold  $3
[*] gems  $5
[*] diamonds  $10
[/list]
Watch the others closely as they always lie about what's in their pockets. Unless they drown (with or without help) and drop them all down. That is when you need to be close to step in, to casually collect. 

Finders keepers, right?

notes.title: Raiders Of The Lost Island - FULLY RELEASED NOW
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy, raiders![/h2]
Our game is NOW fully released on Steam!

[previewyoutube=aM3xAtAeTKI;full][/previewyoutube]

After more than 3 years at sea, now is the time for the most famous adventure! Call your friends, grab your best gear and get aboard. We're sailing for some lost islands, full of treasures, relics, glory, but also deadly perils.

Will your team stick together? Will your friendship be true in front of so many temptations?
Only one way to find out: BUY THE GAME AT LAUNCH and receive our in-game EXCLUSIVE REWARD: "the message in a rum bottle" relic (wonder what it says?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/ba33ef36287d703cc59a1a531c9cd781154ff9f1.png[/img]

And don't forget, we're having the online launch party, streaming live on Steam Broadcasts, today from 19:00 UTC+3. We're gonna play live, both local and online with friends, and we'd love to have you joining. The virtual grog is on the house!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/867980/broadcasts/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/867980/broadcasts/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/ffa9625fe97f3b65de25b3947a295c1a4636891b.png[/img]

But, before embarking on this amazing adventure, let's have a quick look back, to where it all started!
The game came to life in 2017 at Global Game Jam, and its unique semi-cooperative concept proved to be something worth fighting for.

Confirmation received when the game won 2 out of 3 prizes at Dev Play 2017, the games dev conference for Eastern Europe: "Best game of the show" and "Best design".

We continued the work and presented the game at many expos and conferences like London Casual Connect 2018 (Indie Prize finalist), East European Comic Con 2019, and last year Cologne Gamescom 2019 when we entered the Early Access on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/26b8f44fde39c1d62354c04ad45547dcc32881f4.png[/img]

Today, after one year of early access, the game is fully released on Steam, and we're ready to present you all the new features, islands, the whole experience as we initially designed it. Here are a few of the flag features we've included:

- 20 islands in total and 4 adventure sizes to embark on if you're serious about it
- 4 local players with full controller support as well as sharing keyboard
- fighting moves: push, takedowns, counter-takedowns, and lots of shooting
- integrated support for Steam Remote Play, to invite your friends and play online
- lots of new treasures: beside the coins and diamonds, there are gems to dig for and other buried surprises
- expensive and special new relics to collect on your adventures, and score ahead of your friends at the end
- lucky tickets and a whole wheel of fortune. Don't feel lucky enough? Find the daruma relic and your life will change.
- get the birds eggs, they contain treasures and if you're lucky, you may get a rare surprise out of them
- secret relics hidden and hard to find, but definitely worth having
- leaderboards to brag about your score online, especially when you're alone and do your best
- better tutorial and guide book with tips and all the advice a beginner raider needs
- emotes to express what you can't say
- cool and relaxing music, and exciting drums when things get tough at the final wave
- volcanoes, falling rifts, scary pumpkins, bridges, elevators, rolling boulders, and many more features for you to enjoy during your raids!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/59bfb20cfe492b0749250273df15e46e19148754.png[/img]

This being said, our work is not over yet, as we plan for more surprises, updates, support for consoles and other exciting events.

So, if you're ready to get aboard, BUY the game, and tell us your story! Be warned tough, things may get very competitive after a while, as no one wants to do the hard work and just help someone else win!

Remember WIN ALONE, OR DIE TOGETHER!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/52cb9919f0d2b2181c1f85af5a9e5e16e6739fd0.png[/img]

Ready to raid? Welcome aboard!
Sincerely, the Last Tales team

notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Exciting news: After one year of Early Access, we're wrapping things up for the 
[h1]Full Release on September 2nd[/h1]
Get ready to raid and party hard! We'll be live on Steam Broadcasts, celebrating, so join us and help Raiders Of The Lost Island have a great launch! More news about the event soon, in the community and on the game's social media pages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/b32d40ed51dcbee988c2c1800f2df65ce84c1556.png[/img]

Until then, try this Pre-Release Update (v0.40) and help us validate it as a stable build.

One awesome thing, you can now invite your friends to play online, directly from the main menu. It's using the Steam's Remote Play Together which works well enough if you don't have your friends on the couch with you.

Also a series of fixes, polishes, and updates, some new achievements about the hidden relics, which now have some special powers, and the new Daruma relic which brings good luck to those rolling at the Wheel of Fortune. Adjusted the quality settings for more performance and added new tips in the Guide Book and on the loading screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/6193da9bde0d98a389fdd6cc27089331635b3579.png[/img]
Don't worry, we kept a few surprises for the full version too.
So, enjoy the update and let us know if anything is missing. Have fun!
Alex

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content: A script error was fixed on the volcano island when earthquake started (while playing in 4 players).

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Last major update is here, preparing for the full release this summer.
Enjoy new islands, treasures, features and tons of fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/6b1c5e1ef7413e88f25f03f3822d9999a7f745e2.png[/img]

First of all, a couple of [b]NEW ISLANDS[/b] to raid! In total there are now 18 plus a tutorial. The adventure sizes was adjusted, with 5 raids on a small adventure, up to 15 on a long one. And for those true raiders, now there is an [b]EPIC [/b]adventure with all the existing islands. Survive that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/9753dcf94984d9ddb5bd959a2721014478a85de2.png[/img]

We have a new tool, the trusty [b]SHOVEL[/b]. There is rumor that some shiny [b]GEMS[/b] have been buried on the islands. Spot those little twinkles and start [b]DIGGING[/b]! They are more expensive than the old gold coins.

And speaking of tools, some [b]SPECIAL EQUIPMENT[/b] is sometimes delivered in the hideout. We have the air tank that gives you some extra seconds under water, to grab that last coin that always gets you drowned. And the rope, to create smart shortcuts in the levels.

More unique [b]RELICS [/b] to add to your collection for the final auction. The 3 totem heads, that score big time together, the lanterns, that magically turn off if you own more than one, the crystal skull, that is buried somewhere, and quite a few more. Not to mention the secret ones, well hidden in places you'll never think of.

The [b]WHEEL OF FORTUNE[/b] event awaits you after a couple of islands, inviting you to spend your fortune tickets and gain more treasures. More than your friends :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/1bb2c418c63b83003a2cb09c72076d53f6e3a40a.png[/img]

Some islands have now special [b]LOCKED DOORS[/b], that can be unlocked to access shortcut passages or treasures. And the final levels have a [b]TREASURE CHEST[/b], that can only be opened if you bring a [b]SKELETON KEY[/b] with you.

We updated the [b]GUIDE BOOK[/b] and added tips in the loading screen, to remind you the controls and other important stuff, that more experienced raiders know by heart.

A few [b]FUNNY LINES[/b], sometimes smart, sometimes stupid, spoken by the raiders, as they step on the shores of an island. A point to start a quarrel.

Did you ever wonder how your loot compares to what others managed to get? We have [b]STEAM LEADERBOARDS[/b]. Open the Guide Book and check how much others have scored on various adventure sizes, alone or together. Yes, if you are alone, your efforts now can be measured!

And for those who can't find the words to express all this excitement, we have [b]EMOTES[/b]. Just hold Y button for 1 second, then tap any combo of 2 buttons. As a gentleman, pop an angry face, before poking your friend in the head with the controller :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/26c002aa3b8e359e3581aad9d6182a555fd8e856.png[/img]

Finally, the long awaited [b]RELEASE[/b] is planned for this August. Only a few more things to add, and a few more things to polish :) I know I've been saying this for more than 3 years, but this was quite a journey, and I really hope you'll get the best of fun with your friends and families - and not break any friendships over this :D

Enjoy!
Alex

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/fb3bbb26674856f56d6fb61505c02a99d8623723.png[/img]
Additional update with polish and fixes, on top of the new island and the Night Watcher.
Enjoy Halloween with a thematic intro and fun night islands. Beware of the Night Watcher!

Beside the update list in v0.34 (new island), here are some more things:
v0.35
 - fixed bug: rare player stuck in falling state
 - support to remove AFK players in other options menu
 - players who join during adventure enter now with lowest total score - 10, instead of 0
 - input option to control the menu with all gamepads or just one

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/fb3bbb26674856f56d6fb61505c02a99d8623723.png[/img]
New Halloween themed island, introducing The Night Watcher! Plan your moves carefully, hold on to your loot, and stay in cover, because the eye in the night is always searching!

The new map was marked as favorite by default, so it's included in any adventure. In fact you can mark any maps as favorites in the Quick Raids list.

v0.34 [191020]
 - Halloween theme night in main menu (will go away after the event)
 - new island "the night watcher" with Halloween theme and a killer pumpkin
 - no more locked islands in quick raids list
 - support marking islands as favorite in the quick raid list
   (these will be included in adventures with priority)
 - new islands are marked as favorites by default
 - portals in secret tunnels must be entered by facing them now
 - fixed bug: removed forgotten debug keys
 - fixed bug: ring idol dark glow under water
 - fixed bug: rare crash in avatar selection if hat was on and keys pressed fast

Enjoy and party hard!

notes.title: Get ready for Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/a7499842098885321398773a9b4e45319005000d.png[/img]
Hey guys, grab your brooms and carve your pumpkins, because we are getting ready for a cool Halloween party! Stay tuned for a special thematic update with a whole new special level and other surprises!

We're also very excited about the Steam's 'Remote Play Together' feature to come. It's been said that you'll be able to team up and raid together with your far away friends by online streaming your local co-op games. We'll get to beta test this in less than a week!

notes.title: v0.33 Update - Birds and Eggs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32850253/d79142c5cd50a5db2af5f8b32542c638ebc48eec.png[/img]

New feature introducing two funny birds: the toucan and the crow.

They sometimes visit your island and lay an egg. Grab it and carry it with you in the boat, and on the ending screen it will turn into a random treasure. Depending on the egg's origin, chances are to get expensive diamonds or the shiny, shiny new gems. The ruby, the sapphire or the emerald, which you may also find in hideout's boxes, they worth $5 each.

Also a few other improvements, check the list:
v0.33 [190921]
 - new feature: birds and eggs
 - gems: emerald, sapphire, ruby ($5 each) from eggs and hideout boxes
 - fixed missing collisions in some levels
 - adjusted some levels based on gamescom feedback
 - on ending screen, keep the treasure piles visible if too high 
 - can jump in the floating boat from nearby ledges where available
 - hide mouse cursor in full screen modes (for debug menu F1 go windowed)

Have fun, and fight hard for those eggs!
